snapshot_metadata.note: Refresh by running scripts/snapshot_taxonomy.py with --backend-path pointing at a lithrim-backend checkout.

structural_codes.STRUCTURAL_MALFORMED_DATE: HL7/FHIR date field does not conform to required format (e.g. PID-7 birthdate not YYYYMMDD).
structural_codes.STRUCTURAL_MISSING_REQUIRED_SEGMENT: Required HL7 segment is absent (e.g. PV1 in ADT^A04).
structural_codes.STRUCTURAL_INVALID_FIELD_FORMAT: HL7 coded field carries a value outside the allowed value set (e.g. PID-8 gender not in {M,F,O,U,A,N,U}).

structural_codes_note: Structural codes are emitted by deterministic validators (etlp-mapper Jute templates), not by the semantic council. They always route to BLOCK / reject and have no Tier-1 owner-map entry. They exist separately from KNOWN_TAXONOMY_CODES so the paper can measure structural-recall and semantic-recall independently.
